title: Senior Specialist - Fullstack Engineer
description:
Job Description

Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, responsive, and scalable enterprise websites using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies, ensuring performance, accessibility, security, and an exceptional user experience across devices.
Develop and integrate HCL Digital Experience (HCL DX / HCL TX) CMS capabilities, including content models, authoring workflows, reusable components, templates, and content delivery integrations to support enterprise digital platforms.
Implement headless CMS architectures by integrating HCL TX content APIs and REST services with React/Next.js frontends, enabling flexible content delivery, omnichannel experiences, and scalable digital platform solutions.
Develop and maintain reusable frontend components, shared UI libraries, design systems, and modular website architectures aligned with enterprise architecture standards and business requirements.
Own the end-to-end website development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, deployment, production support, and continuous enhancement.
Optimize website performance, Core Web Vitals, SEO, accessibility, caching, and rendering strategies such as server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR), as appropriate.
Integrate websites with enterprise systems and services, including REST APIs, CRM platforms, lead management systems, authentication services, search platforms, analytics, and third-party applications.
Implement secure web application practices, including authentication and authorization, API security, input validation, secure session management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance with enterprise security standards.
Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes using Git-based workflows and enterprise DevOps tools, supporting controlled releases across development, UAT, and production environments.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, UX/UI designers, solution architects, backend developers, QA teams, and external vendors to translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable, and high-quality digital experiences.
Troubleshoot complex frontend, CMS, API integration, content delivery, and production issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions to improve platform stability and reliability.
Contribute to technical documentation, code quality standards, architectural reviews, reusable development practices, and continuous improvements across enterprise website initiatives.
Explore and adopt emerging technologies, headless digital experience capabilities, and AI-enabled development practices to improve developer productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance digital platform capabilities.
